Hydrogens at stereocentres

Card order
How to assign R/S, E/Z and Re/Si
  1. Rank the groups on the atom by the CIP rules: the higher atomic number wins at the first atom; on a tie, compare the sets of atoms one sphere further out, heaviest first, and go on until they differ.
  2. A double bond counts its partner twice: C=O gives the carbon (O, O) and the oxygen (C, C); the extra atom is a duplicate, written (O), and carries nothing further. A lone pair ranks lowest of all (written 0). P=O and S=O count as single bonds, without duplicates.
  3. R/S: look with group 4 pointing away from you. 1 → 2 → 3 clockwise is R, counterclockwise is S. If 4 points toward you, read the turn and reverse it.
  4. E/Z: rank the two groups on each end of the double bond. The two winners on the same side: Z (zusammen); on opposite sides: E (entgegen).
  5. Re/Si: rank the three groups of the trigonal carbon. Seen from your side, 1 → 2 → 3 clockwise is the Re face, counterclockwise the Si face.
